farmToFood.headline: From Farm to Food — in Six Stages
farmToFood.description: Scroll through the full journey below. Every seed, every harvest, every plate is part of one African story.

s1.headline: Seeds of Africa.
s1.description: Sourced from smallholder farms and cooperatives across Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, and Nigeria — maize, cocoa, shea, and indigenous crops like fonio and tiger nuts.

s2.headline: Golden harvest.
s2.description: Hand-picked and mechanically harvested at peak ripeness. Each batch undergoes farm-gate quality grading per Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) protocols.

s3.headline: Modern transformation.
s3.description: HACCP and ISO 22000-certified facilities in the Greater Accra region. Cleaning, sorting, milling, and blending — precision at every step.

s4.headline: Ready for the shelf.
s4.description: Shelf-stable packaging meeting EU, USFDA, and ECOWAS food-safety requirements. Every label tells the origin story of its contents.

s5.headline: Great food.
s5.description: From our kitchens to yours. Jollof spice blends, roasted cocoa nibs, cassava flour — nutritious, culturally rooted ingredients and ready meals.

s6.headline: For the world.
s6.description: Distributed across 24+ markets through Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) corridors and partnerships with EU and North American importers.

about.headerText: At AcresxManna, we are dedicated to feeding the world. We are at the forefront of satisfying the increasing need for safe and wholesome food.
about.originParagraph1: AcresxManna Group is redefining how Africa feeds itself and the world. We are a pan-African agrofood group of company committed to building a reliable, sustainable, and equitable food future. Our model integrates farming, food processing, financing, media, and distribution—ensuring quality and access at every stage of the agrofood value chain. Our collective of companies serves both rural producers and urban consumers, creating value through innovation, integrity, and deep community partnerships. We specialize in blending local knowledge with modern practices to empower smallholder farmers, enhance food security, and deliver authentic African food experiences globally. Whether it's through modern farms, inclusive finance, logistics, or storytelling, our mission is simple: to nourish lives, preserve heritage, and strengthen economies from the ground up.
about.originParagraph2: From the small farms of West Africa to global food markets, AcresxManna Group was born out of a belief that Africa can feed itself—and the world—with dignity and excellence. We started with one goal: to bridge the gap between African agricultural abundance and market accessibility. Along the way, we saw the need for more than just farming. We saw the need for structure, support, and systems that work—from seed to shelf. Today, our brands support farmers with improved practices, offer consumers wholesome food options, and bring the vibrance of African culture to global audiences.

about.missionText: To build a diversified and dynamic portfolio of farms and firms that excels in adding significant value throughout the agrofood valuechain.

about.focus4Desc: Connecting local products with domestic and global markets.
about.focus5Desc: Sharing the African food story with the world through content and campaigns.

about.value2Desc: Collaboration is at our core, fostering alliances that unlock shared value and drive global impact.
about.value3Desc: Our investments focus on sustainable innovations that shape the future of agriculture and food systems.
about.value4Desc: With creativity and boldness, we bring innovative solutions to life, transforming challenges into opportunities.
about.value5Desc: We champion ventures that are not only profitable but also rooted in integrity and social responsibility.
about.value6Desc: Our robust financial foundation empowers us to drive impactful projects and sustain long-term growth.
about.brand1Desc: An agricultural sourcing and farm network arm, building and managing relationships with farmers and producers, ensuring consistent supply of agricultural produce.
about.brand2Desc: The bakery division of AcresxManna, focused on producing fresh bread and pastries. Converting agricultural inputs into finished staple food products.
about.brand3Desc: A consumer food brand producing and distributing food products designed for affordability, accessibility, and everyday consumption.
about.brand4Desc: Developed for retail, distribution, and export markets, representing AcresxManna's primary branded product identity, bringing African foods to consumers.

about.cert2Desc: Ensures products comply with approved national standards for safety, quality, and consumer protection.

expressions.headline: Together we are AcresxManna.
expressions.description: Our expressions are how we deliver our mission — across farms, foods, storytelling, and social impact.
expressions.expr1Desc: Your online grocery store for the bold and the flavourful. We bring together the best of Africa's independent producers, farmers, and food makers.
expressions.expr2Desc: At African Food King, tradition meets innovation to bring the vibrant flavors of African cuisine to the world.
expressions.expr3Tagline: Feed the Mind, Nourish the Future.
expressions.expr3Desc: Our social impact arm — because real change starts with access. We believe food is a right, not a luxury. But instead of handouts, we fund education that empowers communities to feed themselves for life.
expressions.expr4Desc: From savory bites to sweet treats, HappyMan delivers African-inspired comfort food you'll love. Ready-to-eat meals, perfect for homes, offices, and life on the move.
expressions.expr5Desc: Panem Vitae is our agricultural powerhouse — building and managing farms that grow quality produce with impact. From land access to crop cultivation, we offer tailored agri-solutions across regions.
expressions.expr6Desc: We facilitate the trade and supply of high-quality commodities across markets. Whether you're a farmer, bulk buyer, or trader, we connect you to better opportunities in the commodity space.

impact.description: Every number on this page is a person, a community, or a meal on a table we helped get there.
impact.story1Text: "Since joining the AcresxManna outgrower program in 2022, I received training on improved OPV maize varieties, a guaranteed off-take contract, and a 32% higher price at harvest. My children's school fees are now covered every term."
impact.story2Text: "Premium cocoa prices year on year, plus a school scholarship fund covering 240 farmer families. We've invested in fermentation sheds and now grade our beans to EU export standard ourselves."
impact.story3Text: "I started as a seasonal temp on the packaging line in 2021. After completing AcresxManna's internal skills program, I now lead a team of 14 in the milling department, working with GMP and HACCP protocols daily."
